items.signal: Controllers are already trained/qualified; replay does not establish three-level end-to-end learning.
Opaque L2-request -> L1-current-context mapping is supplied by the harness.
Internal middle drift/currentness propagation remains untested on current main.
Nested composition is observationally equivalent to a flattened top-boundary handler at the tested surface; nesting alone does not justify a new hierarchy mechanism.
E provenance, F value-conflict, and model hardware-fit seams remain orthogonal.
